question:
Select the figure that will come next (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac623cc12dd0baff99723229551a77dc550ac0899b4fd04f02fc1a64186dd89a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:** Each image is moving upside down and a new image is inserted in series after 2 image.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e35ffc556851d4dbfd6577f161102e26ee2f8916a0374ca548b5ad41dd7c5057.png] 

So, **image 4** will come next in the following series.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 4'.***
